text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Eddie Fenech Adami promises a future of prosperity, opportunity and strong family values.
- Electoral campaign ends today. Political parties plan to end their campaigns with a flourish, including two mass meetings on the island of Gozo.
- Nationalist Party is the future, Fenech Adami tells his party supporters.
- Foreign Minister Guido de Marco says NP victory would be vote for European Union membership. Malta applied to join the EU in 1990. Opposition Labour Party is against membership.
- Labour leader Alfred Sant insists on corruption allegations against ministers who have rebutted his allegations.
